title: Albumin context of the calcium–phosphate product does not establish incremental pulse-pressure prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: In operationally untreated NHANES adults, adding albumin-by-phosphate context beyond routine nonlinear covariates and the calcium-phosphate product changed external MSE by 0.0041 mmHg² (1000 source/target-refit bootstrap95% interval -1.3186 to 1.5251). Source n3530, external cycle n3065. Source CV and weighted target performance worsened, so incremental benefit is not established. Exploratory cross-sectional prediction in previously reused public cycles; not a calcification or clinical utility test. AI-authored with offline author checks, not independent peer review.
